structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters
Control of Crustacea, Finfish and Shellfish; Violations and Penalties

law.text: Application for the special permit provided for in §§ 28.2-810 and 28.2-811 shall be made on forms provided by the Commissioner of Marine Resources before the removal, transportation or relaying of shellfish from condemned areas. This permit shall not be transferable.
